column4: start of a round, each player untaps their non gathered unpreppared heroes
column6: there are 3 ways of winning: Assassination, Monetary or Control
column8: HP: tanky characters should be about 8 HP, and the lowest HP should be 3. TANKY characters should NEVER (only in SUPER specific circumstances) be one shotable
column10: actions use action points. there are 3 types: MOVE action. ATTACK action and SPECIAL action. MOVE and ATTACK actions cost only 1 ACTION POINT. SPECIAL actions may cost more
column12: There is now a different between a tapped entity being stunned and being gathered. The concept is the following: an entity is unprepared if it is tapped, and an unprepared entity cannot perform any actions during that round. Gathering an entity and stunning it both unprepare the entity. At the start of the gathering phase, you prepare every non gathered entity, than go along the same way to gather action points (so stun isen't as powerful)
column14: Since this is an hexagon board, there has to be a notation. each tile has an X,Y coordinate. imagining each tile horizontally. directions: UP(-Y), UP_RIGHT(+X), UP_LEFT(-XY), DOWN(+Y), DOWN_RIGHT(+XY), DOWN_LEFT(-X)

column4: action gathering phase: P1 starts from one of their heroes, and then goes through each one. if that hero is tapped, untap it and go to the next. if it is not tapped, P1 may tap it. P1 may only tap up to 3 heroes during this phase. after that, P1 gets ACTION POINTS equal to the AP stat of their tapped heroes. THEN, P2 does this aswell
column6: Assassination Victory: at the start of the game, each player assigns one of their heroes as their team's VIP. on each round, each VIP can use an action without spending an ACTION POINT (this will still count for ending the turn) (it may use this action even if tapped). the VIP also has the respawn reduced by 1. if a team kills the opposing VIP 3 times, they achieve an Assassination Victory
column8: MOVE: the lowest move possible should be 2 (base). average should be 3-4. 5 should be FAST and 6 should be AT MAX, only 1 hero specific to being mobile
column10: MOVE: to perform a move, the hero moves 1 tile at a time, until it has moved X tiles, where X is the amount it should move (in the case of a standard MOVE action, it's equal to its MOVE stat). it CANNOT pass through tiles with other heroes or entities, nor can it pass through walls. on standard MOVE actions and if stated "move up to", that hero may not move the amount stated, BUT has to move atleast 1 tile
column12: Also, now in the gathering phase, the amount of action points you gain from dead heroes scales like this: 1 dead - 1 AP; 2 dead - 3 AP; 3 or more dead - 6 AP;
column14: for teleports, the (X,Y) is the tile that the tp points to (in this case, for all tiles that have arrows pointing at edges)

column2: P1 picks a hero, P2 picks 2, and this goes until each have picked 7 heroes
column4: NOW, turns will begin starting with P1
column6: Monetary Victory: there exist the MONEY TILES, one on each side. at the end of a round or after the first movement phase in the pregame, any hero on a MONEY TILE gets 1 MONEY. ALSO, at the end of a round, if there is an hero in one of their starting tiles with MONEY, it may deposit that MONEY (has much as they want). if a hero dies with MONEY, the hero that killed it gets half of that MONEY, rounded up (if no hero killed it, the MONEY dissappears). if a team has 7 or more MONEY, it achieves a Monetary Victory
column8: ATK: shoudn't really go over 3 for BASE DAMAGE, most characters should, at a baseline, have to attack twice to kill another hero
column10: ATTACK: attacks are performed in a straight line. the attack must target something IN RANGE (this means, up to X tiles in a straight line, where X is equal to that hero's REACH). an attack cannot go through walls OR enemy entities, but may go through allied entities. the targetted entity, if the attack is succesful, receives damage equal to the attacker's ATTACK
column14: for high ground tiles (or other tiles with arrows pointing at real direction), the (X,Y) points at the direction (i.e: (+,0) has a plus on X and 0 on Y, so it's up right)

column2: each player places them face down in their starting tiles
column4: ON THEIR TURN: the player uses ACTION POINTS. once that player has used 2 ACTION POINTS or has no ACTION POINTS left, it passes their turn. IF that player is P1 and it's their first turn. instead they pass the turn once they have used 1 ACTION POINT
column6: Control Victory: in the middle of the board there is a CONTROL TILE. outside of the game, there also exists a CONTROL BAR (a row of 9 tiles, 4 from one team, then 1 from nothing, then 3 from the other team. the CONTROL TRACKER starts in the middle tile). at the end of a round, if there is a hero in the control tile, move the TRACKER one tile towards that team's spot on the CONTROL BAR. heroes on the CONTROL TILE cannot perform any action except from MOVE. if a team reaches their final tile on the CONTROL BAR, it achieves a Control Victory
column8: REACH: completely subjective, 1 is Melee, 2 is Average and like slight ranged, 3 is already with some Range, and 4+ is reserved for Snipers
column10: SPECIAL: specified on their text, are actions specific to each hero. vary in cost and effect

column2: they flip all their heroes face up
column4: once players have used all their ACTION POINTS, the round ends (note: TAPPED heroes cannot use actions)
column8: AP: average should be 2, but can vary WILDLY, does not need a reference

column2: PREGAME movement phase: P1 moves 1 hero, then P2 moves 2 hero, continue until all heroes have been moved (no hero can move more than once during this stage
column4: END OF ROUND: give 1 MONEY to each hero on a MONEY tile, move the control bar according to what hero is on the CONTROL POINT, reduce all respawn timers by 1, make the P2 the P1 for the next round, then go to the next round
